$comment: Bootstrap payload written to MACP_BOOTSTRAP_FILE before spawning the initiator agent of a Decision Mode run. See macp-agent-bootstrap.schema.json.
_invalid_because: initiator.session_start carries the removed `context` key. RFC-MACP-0001 Section 7.4.2 records that the bytes `context` field has been removed, superseded by context_id (field 8) and extensions (field 9), so a bootstrap naming it describes a field no runtime has. This key survives as a vestigial, unmapped field on macp-sdk-typescript's own BootstrapPayload.initiator.session_start type, but fromBootstrap() never reads it into the constructed config — the removal is at the wire/RFC level, not merely unused by one SDK's reader. Isolates initiator.session_start's additionalProperties keyword.
